title: Labour, Birth & the First Weeks
promise: Know what to do the moment it starts — and what to do next.
summary: Written for two people who have never done this before: how to tell early labour from the real thing, when to stay home and when to ring, what to pack, how to write a birth plan that still works when the plan changes, and what the birth partner actually does hour by hour. Then the part nobody prepares you for — the first hour, the first fortnight of feeding and nappies, and a proper account of recovery. UK maternity care throughout.
